intro: Pelturas Whitemoon's desperate quest to heal his daughter Relara continues in Astranaar. While the sacred water of Elune's Tear calmed her terrifying nightmares, a fierce fever still grips her. Guided by Orendil Broadleaf's botanical knowledge, adventurers journey south to harvest a cooling, luminescent dust settled among ancient night elven stones.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Elune's Tear washed clear some of my daughter's sickness. Her nightmares are lessened and I thank the goddess for her blessing. But... Fever still rages within her.
Orendil told me of a frosted dust found among the Ruins of Stardust. Perhaps it will abate Relara's fever. Gather some of the dust, then please return to me.
The Ruins of Stardust lie to the south, friend. May Elune speed your journey.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you yet have the Stardust, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You gathered the dust! I will create a poultice from these—it should bring down Relara's fever.
Thank you again, friend. Without your help, my child would surely perish.
